design.hypothesis: Remove arbitrary inherited contact-logit scale as a family prior. At otherwise identical tensor initialization, training evidence, budgets and gates, probability-neutral contact normalization may repair effect acquisition and improve retained confidence. This is a separately frozen study after the complete failed v1 result, not a retry.
design.world: Require all ten accepted native SET v2 checkpoints and their complete KEEP decision. All 562 native parameters remain frozen. NAND language training uses each matching seed's acquired NAND world; the same fitted language weights are tested with both acquired NAND and NOR worlds.
design.language: Same 92-scalar state and exact 88-scalar inheritance plus 4 zero added scalars. The only model change persists at every call: concatenate contact_log_softmax+log(2) with the two raw SET logits, then apply four-way log_softmax. Initially contact/SET family mass=.5/.5 and each SET direction=.25; parent conditional contact probabilities preserved. Later SET scores learn freely. All 92 language parameters train; all 562 world parameters frozen. No lexical word selects semantics.
design.teaching: The same sixteen published v1 observed teaching episodes: two words lights/zef, SVO/OSV, two contrasting anchors and both physically exposed persistent modes. Each endpoint alone admits multiple actions; the intersection across four examples identifies each taught word/layout cell. New words never occur in VOS training. Rehearse only the exact previously accepted 1152-event TRAIN tape, never an evaluation bank. Grounded and text-only see observed readings; only the parser control loads action labels.
design.optimization: One fixed 256-update Adam fit per arm/seed. Objective is .5 mean new-teaching NLL plus .5 mean old-rehearsal NLL (parser action NLL instead of endpoint NLL). Fresh Adam betas .9/.999, eps 1e-8, weight_decay 0, amsgrad false. Clip norm5, learning rate.02, CPU ceiling400seconds per fit. No selection, early stopping, retries or added examples after opening.
design.challenge: Fresh hub_return4 and triangle_fan5 ordered participant schedules, rotating SVO/OSV/VOS through each mixed contact/SET episode. Both directions, physical modes, known/unresolved mode contexts, four anchors, two effect phases, and four final action alternatives. Previously opened TRAIN-withheld new-word/VOS cells and fresh participants are audited with their distinct evidence roles. Every forecast precedes its reading; later forecasts receive actual earlier feedback. Report dependent views as such, not independent trials or autonomous rollouts.
design.goals: Each final group supplies four hypothetical messages from one identical observed prefix. Score all four two-bit goals with spectator coordinates fixed, including impossible goals. Choose the message maximizing its saved full-world target probability; deterministic first-index ties. Measure oracle-optimal choice and regret under the frozen conditional oracle. Effect-sensitive cases are determined before opening by unequal best contact/SET utilities; report SET-required and contact-required subsets separately. Goal selection is over supplied meanings and candidates, not natural-language goal parsing or autonomous planning.
design.lexical_identity: Copy the exact published v1 bounded exact-string registry from observed training tokens, preserving all features. Distinct identities cannot share the effective vector: only newly colliding vectors are replaced by deterministic identity-derived features. No semantics/POS/sense are registered. Explicit unknown probes return separate exact typed unresolved identities and no forecast. This is bounded lexical storage and abstention, not a claim of unrestricted polysemy learning.
design.controls: The parser has the same 92 parameters and privileged action supervision. The 1048-parameter text-only model receives words and identity positions but no state readings or mode context. Current-word masking zeros lexical features while preserving supplied identities, layout and canonical prefix belief. All controls are reported. Neither parameter matching with text-only nor matched consumed compute is claimed. V2 text-only checkpoints and every report field except resource timing must exactly reproduce v1. Fresh parser is normalized v2; opened parser is explicitly archived v1 descriptive evidence, not a v2 parser. Receipt revalidated before collection/scoring.
design.criteria: Every law/seed and every nonempty family/layout/new-old/effect stratum must meet the frozen identifiable, action and probability thresholds. Zero unsupported MAP worlds and zero known-fixed-coordinate errors. Whole identifiable trajectories and paired reversals >=.95; bilingual aligned world TV<=.05. All goal strata >=.95 optimal choices, mean regret<=.01 and maximum regret<=.05. Grounded effect-sensitive goal accuracy must improve over masked and text-only by>=.1, with both effect directions present. All scientific failures produce complete reports.
design.retention: Compare all six historical language banks against accepted native SET v2 forecasts on identical acquired worlds. Zero exact-world regressions, mean truth NLL<=.05 per bank/law/seed, and exact equality of candidate four-action MAP with archived two-order MAP. Never renormalize away new SET mass. Report every NLL/truth-probability/vector-drift delta and SET probability mass; no exact language tensor/probability equality is required after language training.
design.provenance: Publish frozen source/data/runtime before fitting, all 15 actual language checkpoints before collection, and every fresh/retention forecast before opening evaluator targets. Exclusive output directories, strict complete inventories, immutable native checkpoints and complete runtime identity. A separate stdlib saved-record auditor validates raw evidence before target parsing and checks the scored decision without running the model or original scorer. Bind full completed v1 source/data/weights/raw/scored and TRAIN-only diagnostic evidence, with final v1 result publication as ancestor. New raw inventory: 100 traces plus 1 lexical receipt; 546,240 rows total. Extra TRAIN diagnostics from v1 remain separately counted.
design.limits: Development G3 completion is bounded to the supplied two-mode world, stable identity markers, action candidates, token/layout features, controlled three-token forms and finite goal candidates. G1/G2 development readiness is inherited. Formal scientific admission remains open, independent custody and matched consumed compute are absent, and the inclusive 2000-line target remains unmet. No production runtime, authority or ABI changes. V1 failed all 10 law/seed conditions, including bilingual TV and KL failures, retained NLL failures, and seed 37 exact world/action regressions. Normalization alone is an unverified hypothesis for these broader defects; no success asserted before full scoring.
design.freshness: Fresh hub_return4 and triangle_fan5 participant graphs, both disjoint from 70 prior source-defined recipe entries under ordered and unordered multigraph canonicalization; identity seed 20261102501 and challenge seed 20261102502. Previously opened new-word/VOS cells remain TRAIN-withheld but are not claimed fresh. Four training artifacts copied byte-for-byte from published v1. Six old language banks and the complete opened v1 challenge remain regression evidence.
design.opened_regression: Collect grounded canonical and current-lexical-masked forecasts on all opened v1 challenge points. Repeat all unchanged v1 candidate gates using archived parser baseline and exact-reproduced text-only control. Additionally require zero formerly correct identifiable-world regressions and zero formerly correct taught-action regressions for canonical forecasts. Retain all actual-world/ambiguous and masked repair/regression inventories descriptively. All new opened checks fixed before v2 fitting.

decision_order: STOP_INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION for malformed evidence, provenance/mutation/runtime failures or incomplete execution
REVISE_EFFECT_ROLE_GROUNDING if any valid completed-fit competence, goal or retention criterion fails
DEVELOPMENT_G3_COMPLETE / PROCEED_TO_G4 only if every prospective criterion and identity control passes
